summary: PR-1806 changes bearer token generation in the security-sensitive payments.session component. The ticket, the independent code review on head, and CI on head with the SES-1 control test passing are in order. However, the only security review approves commit e9d0f2f. It was given before the later commit c651a1a, which by its own description changes token entropy, a behaviour change that voids the approval under CHG-3/CHG-5. With no security review covering the merged commit, CHG-5 is refuted and the change is rejected.
